outputs.label: Primary process (rule-based)
outputs.expr: i.pH==null||i.pCO2==null||i.HCO3==null ? '—' : (i.pH<7.35 ? (i.HCO3<22 ? 'Metabolic acidosis' : (i.pCO2>45 ? 'Respiratory acidosis' : 'Acidemia (mixed/unclear)')) : (i.pH>7.45 ? (i.HCO3>26 ? 'Metabolic alkalosis' : (i.pCO2<35 ? 'Respiratory alkalosis' : 'Alkalemia (mixed/unclear)')) : 'Near-normal pH (consider mixed)'))

outputs.label: Compensation check (metabolic acidosis only)
outputs.expr: i.HCO3==null||i.pCO2==null ? '—' : (function(){const exp=1.5*i.HCO3+8; if(i.pCO2>=exp-2 && i.pCO2<=exp+2) return 'Appropriate respiratory compensation'; if(i.pCO2>exp+2) return 'Concurrent respiratory acidosis'; return 'Concurrent respiratory alkalosis';})()

outputs.label: Corrected AG (albumin-adjusted)
outputs.expr: (i.Na!=null && i.Cl!=null && i.HCO3!=null && i.Alb!=null) ? ((i.Na - (i.Cl + i.HCO3)) + 0.25*(40 - i.Alb)) : null

cards.title: Delta gap
cards.subtitle: Uses shared store AG (from Anion gap card)

outputs.label: Delta ratio: (AG-AGref)/(HCO₃ref-HCO₃)
outputs.expr: (s.AG!=null && i.HCO3!=null && i.AGref!=null && i.HCO3ref!=null) ? ((s.AG - i.AGref) / (i.HCO3ref - i.HCO3)) : null

outputs.label: Rule-of-thumb interpretation
outputs.expr: (s.AG==null || i.HCO3==null || i.AGref==null || i.HCO3ref==null) ? '—' : (function(){const r=(s.AG - i.AGref)/(i.HCO3ref - i.HCO3); if(!Number.isFinite(r)) return '—'; if(r<0.4) return 'Consider pure normal AG acidosis'; if(r<0.8) return 'Mixed: high AG + normal AG acidosis'; if(r<=2.0) return 'Consistent with high AG acidosis'; return 'Consider concurrent metabolic alkalosis or chronic resp acidosis';})()
